ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low contrast due to high-key lighting; approximately 65% low-intensity (dark-grey) to 35% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity dark wedge extending from peduncle to notch; high-intensity light-grey mottling concentrated in the central-medial regions of both lobes, exhibiting irregular, non-geometric boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped depression; calculated interior angle at approximately 115 degrees with a deep bounding-box penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serration along the continuous linear boundary; right lobe trailing edge shows 5-7 distinct small-amplitude peaks; left lobe shows a smoother, more eroded topography.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Compound s-curve fitted to the trailing edge; concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to a wide convex arc toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density cluster of high-intensity circular pixel groups on the extreme lateral right tip; scattered individual white punctate marks across the primary dark-pigmented central area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the left lobe, oriented at roughly 45-degree angles to the fluke's horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent, irregular cluster of barnacle colonization or localized scarring at the right lateral tip; minor distal margin irregularities on the left lateral tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel saturation and overexposure on the water-subject interface, obscuring fine detail at the absolute distal margins.
